currentDesign.presentation: Paper-calendar page with binding details, closer labels, larger text and gentle hover feedback.
currentDesign.animation: One 650ms page turn on mount/date change; a 200ms paper-only hover lift/tilt and shadow. No ambient loops or motion controls.
currentDesign.reducedMotion: Removes the turn and hover movement; open native dialogs suspend the turn.
currentDesign.dateSource: Existing WorkspaceModel.date formatted at local noon; no additional hook, timer, observer or storage.
currentDesign.accessibility: Complete local date is real screen-reader text; narrow visual abbreviations do not remove it.

coverage: Both themes, twelve widths and two font contexts; full desktop/standard short narrow labels, larger font floors and centered non-overlapping fields.
Shared date DOM across normal routes, UTC/local calendar separation, year/month rollover and isolated tutorial midnight.
Finite turn settles and does not replay on navigation; actual new dates turn once; hover lifts only the tile, leaves labels/data intact and honors reduced motion.
Daily plan directly below Overview in desktop/compact navigation, same routes and no saved-data changes.
Existing search, theme, shared visual-layout, graph fitting, midnight draft and all thirteen Atlas motion regressions.
